title: Senior Technical Architect - LSC
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        The Senior Technical Architect (Senior TA) role is part of Salesforce Professional Services in Iberia — a team of delivery professionals working directly with Spain and Portugal's enterprise customers. You'll join a practice navigating one of the most technically demanding moments in its history: the shift to Agentforce delivery at enterprise scale, in regulated industries, in Spanish.  As a Senior TA specialised in  Life Sciences , you are the technical authority for our most complex pharma, biotech and medtech programs. You will own end-to-end solution architecture across  Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud , Health Cloud, Data Cloud and Agentforce, and you will lead architecture for programs that coexist with, integrate with or migrate from  Veeva Systems  (CRM, Vault, Network). You'll be a trusted advisor for CIO/CTO-level and IT leadership stakeholders, set the technical direction for your engagements, and raise the bar for the Iberia architecture community.   What You'll Actually Be Doing:   Architect & Lead   Own the end-to-end solution architecture of large, multi-cloud, multi-workstream Life Sciences programs, from discovery through go-live and hypercare  Define target-state architectures for Life Sciences Cloud (commercial engagement, HCP/HCO management, omnichannel, field force effectiveness, patient/provider journeys) and for Veeva-to-Salesforce coexistence, migration or replacement scenarios  Set and govern architecture standards, patterns and review processes; lead architecture review boards and make (and defend) the hard design calls  Identify and mitigate technical risk early; act as the final technical escalation point on your engagements  Ensure designs meet the regulatory and compliance expectations of the industry (GxP, CSV/validation, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, Sunshine Act / transparency regulations, consent and data privacy)    Integrate & Engineer   Design enterprise integration architectures between Salesforce and the life sciences landscape: Veeva CRM/Vault/Network, MDM, ERP, data warehouses, marketing automation, safety and medical systems  Define event-driven and API-led patterns (REST/SOAP, Platform Events, CDC) and lead middleware strategy (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, other iPaaS)  Architect complex data models, master data strategy (HCP/HCO, product, consent) and large-scale data migrations, including from Veeva  Design Data Cloud and Agentforce solutions: unified profiles, segmentation, grounding, guardrails and the Einstein Trust Layer in regulated settings  Review and guide code quality in Apex and LWC; work hands-on in Python or JavaScript/Node.js for tooling, automation and prototyping  Define environment, CI/CD and release strategies (Git, DevOps Center or equivalent) for large programs    Advise & Influence   Be the trusted technical advisor of customer IT leadership, translating business strategy and regulatory constraints into a pragmatic architecture roadmap  Lead technical discovery and design workshops with business and IT stakeholders  Produce and own the key architecture artefacts: solution architecture, data and integration architecture, security model, non-functional requirements, migration and cutover strategy  Partner with Sales and pre-sales on shaping, estimating and de-risking Life Sciences opportunities and SOWs  Represent Salesforce Professional Services in executive conversations, steering committees and customer events    Enable & Grow   Mentor and coach Technical Architects and Technical Consultants, building the next generation of architects in the practice  Build and share Life Sciences and Veeva-related assets, accelerators, reference architectures and lessons learned across Iberia and EMEA  Drive technical excellence and champion adoption of AI tooling in delivery  Maintain and grow certifications aligned with the practice (Life Sciences, Agentforce, Data Cloud, Architect Journey)  Lead tech club sessions, internal demos and knowledge-sharing initiatives    You're Our Person If...   8+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in consulting or professional services, with 3+ years in an architect role leading the technical design of large, multi-cloud programs  Proven track record in  Life Sciences  (pharma, biotech, medtech) delivering with  Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud / Health Cloud  and/or  Veeva Systems  (CRM, Vault, Network), including coexistence or migration scenarios  Deep understanding of Life Sciences commercial and medical processes: HCP/HCO engagement, call planning, omnichannel, samples, consent management, MLR/approved content, field force operations  Working knowledge of industry regulation and compliance: GxP, computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, transparency and aggregate-spend reporting  Strong engineering background: Apex, LWC, REST/SOAP integrations, and fluency in at least one general-purpose language ( Python ,  JavaScript/TypeScript  or equivalent)  Expertise in integration and data architecture: MuleSoft or other iPaaS, MDM, large data volumes, data migration, SQL/SOQL, JSON/XML  Experience leading customer-facing architecture at senior IT level, with excellent communication and executive presence  Experience mentoring and leading other architects and consultants  Practical, daily use of AI tools (Copilot/Agentforce-style coding assistants, ChatGPT/Claude) for design, research and productivity  Fluent in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus for our Iberia coverage)  Salesforce certifications: Application Architect and/or System Architect required (or equivalent), plus relevant Cloud Consultant certifications; working towards Certified Technical Architect (CTA) is highly valued    Even Better If...   Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or an advanced stage in the CTA journey  Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud or Data Cloud certifications  Hands-on delivery of Agentforce use cases in Life Sciences (e.g. HCP assistants, medical inquiry, field rep copilots)  Veeva certifications or in-depth Veeva Vault / Veeva CRM implementation experience  Experience in a Veeva-to-Salesforce migration program  Experience with validated environments and formal quality systems in pharma  Background in software engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline  Experience with CI/CD, source control and DevOps at scale for Salesforce  Curiosity about LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and AI-augmented solutions  Portuguese language skills and experience with customers across Spain and Portugal             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.        Posting Statement     Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.    Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
